title: Manetta and Alex Bigard in the Martel band; no New Orleans professors
summary: Manuel Manetta and Alex Bigard had played with the Martels earlier, but Joe never knew them or any New Orleans professor teaching in Baton Rouge.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: Before I got in that band, at one time Manuel Manetta and Barney's brother Alex also had played in that same band.
But you didn't know Alex then.
I didn't know Alex or Manuel Manetta. I didn't know them.
Did any of those teachers... Manetta used to teach, I know.
Yes. Well, Professor I think they used to call him.
That's Manetta. Did he come to Baton Rouge to teach, or did he just...
Did any of the New Orleans professors come to Baton Rouge...
No, not that I know of.
I often wondered about it. I've never asked anybody that before. Because they taught so many people in New Orleans, I often wondered if they made a little round of the country towns.
No. If they did, I didn't know anything about it.
